title: Record geometric multiplicity 12 for eigenvalue 2 on the pinned 216-by-216 matrix
body:
<!-- CURSOR_AGENT_PR_BODY_BEGIN -->

## Change and mathematical scope

Proof for one pinned matrix. On the integer matrix of `B = 4 A_1` in the joint `(+1,+1)` basis of dimension 216, the rational rank of `M - 8 I` is 204. Eigenvalue 2 of `A_1` has geometric multiplicity 12. The same eigenvalue has algebraic multiplicity 12, because a positive diagonal makes `M - 8 I` self-adjoint and the kernel Gram form is nondegenerate, so the ascent is 1.

The rank modulo `1000003` and modulo `1000033` is 204. Each modular rank is a lower bound on the rational rank. Equality uses the explicit integer kernel of 12 vectors and a nonzero 204-by-204 minor.

No new kappa. The selected conditional kappa stays `781451/250000000`. This does not change the selected frontier.

Evidence class: a proof for this one pinned matrix. It is not a heuristic search and not a census of the other eigenvalues or of the other three joint sign spaces.

The catalogue card asks for a formal caller binding. PR #6964 pinned this matrix and recorded algebraic multiplicity 12 for eigenvalue 2. PR #7018 computed the rational nullity of `M` and left the shifted elimination of `M - 8 I` unrun. `scripts/find_overlap.py` on 2026-11-10T10:33:41Z, against upstream `17469fff`, searched 10178 HEAD notes, 339 open PRs, and 7013 discussion records, with pagination complete. Those three phrases matched only this computation and PR #7018, which asks the question. The 48-by-48 nullity is a different matrix.

## Validation

CPython 3.12, standard library only.

```sh
python3 -B -W error research/a1-joint-216-eigenvalue-2/verify.py
python3 -B -O research/a1-joint-216-eigenvalue-2/verify.py
python3 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/a1-joint-216-eigenvalue-2 --check-only
python3 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/a1-joint-216-eigenvalue-2
```

Marker `PASS_A1_JOINT_216_EIGENVALUE_2`. Metadata check `PASS_PACKAGE_METADATA_AND_PINS`. Registered replay returned `PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE` with outcome `completed`. Commit-byte check `PASS_RESEARCH_COMMIT_BYTES`. Evidence class: a proof for this one pinned matrix. Kernel certificate SHA256 `23262c04465589eef2ea32c116de7e8b1aac284373d6bf842ea36842aebc4e54`.

The free diagonal is `8, 8, 8, 8, 8, 8, 1, 1, 1, 34, 1, 34`, with product `2^20 * 17^2`. Kernel entries lie in `-120..120`. The 204-by-204 minor is `257823` modulo `1000003` and `857057` modulo `1000033`. The kernel Gram determinant is `686998` modulo `1000003` and `166386` modulo `1000033`.

Rejection controls: `M` itself does not annihilate this kernel; `M - 7 I` does not either; an off-diagonal increment breaks the scaling identity; a zeroed kernel vector loses the positive free diagonal; a repeated pivot row makes the minor determinant 0; changing the recorded factor `(12, (-2, 1))` to multiplicity 11 fails the comparison. A 3-by-3 fixture has rank 2 and kernel `(1, -2, 1)`. A 2-by-2 shift fixture has kernel `(1, 0)`.

Selected-baseline orientation returned `PASS_RESEARCH_BASELINE_BINDINGS_ONLY` for kappa `781451/250000000`.

Not run: Lean, Docker, the degree-881 replay, a selected cold replay, a recomputation of the degree-216 characteristic polynomial, and the eigenvalue-0 kernel.

## Credit

JoyboyBrian's handoff is discussion comment 19144258. The sign-stabilizer split supplied `g`, `t`, and dimension 216. PR #6964 pinned the basis, the matrix, and algebraic multiplicity 12 for eigenvalue 2. PR #7018 recorded geometric multiplicity 24 for eigenvalue 0 and left this shifted elimination open. Ali Romman's PR4958 and PR4720 retain the query and the Bell action. Nick Petalas's PR5120 is the degree-410 lower bound. Krzysztof Wojt's `research/exact-one-slot-gram` is the degree-881 annihilator. The doubled representation comes from PR1719.

Prepared by unpaidmoon with substantial Cursor Grok assistance. The assistant derived the kernel and checked the rank. This is not an independent human or proof-kernel review. New work is Apache-2.0.

## Open next questions

- Geometric multiplicity of eigenvalue `-2` on this same matrix, the nullity of `M + 8 I`. The recorded algebraic multiplicity is 12. The shifted elimination was not run.
- Geometric multiplicity of eigenvalue 2 on each of the other three joint sign spaces. They share the characteristic polynomial, and their matrices are not pinned here. Eigenvalue 0 on those spaces remains the separate open question of PR #7018.

## Workflow feedback (optional)

https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1200

The pinned matrix is sparse with entries in `-28..28`, and the kernel of `M - 8 I` has entries at most 120, so one 20-bit prime reconstructs the kernel and the exact product `(M - 8 I) v = 0` finishes the rank proof.
